import io,json,os,sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ['WB_SCRIPTS'])
WB = os.environ['WB_HOME']
import platform_ops
p = platform_ops.spawn_group([sys.executable, '-c', 'print("CHILD_OK")'],
                             cwd=os.path.dirname(WB),
                             stdout=-1, stderr=-1)
out, err = p.communicate(timeout=60)
text = (out or b'').decode('utf-8', 'replace')
print('rc=%s stdout=%r' % (p.returncode, text.strip()))
assert 'CHILD_OK' in text, 'real: 子进程没跑出预期输出'
print('OK')
